translated_text: Nuremberg, March 15, 2013. My little girl, I've just finished again and want to write a few lines before I hurry on. In Munich, I read your letter with great joy. I, my dear, I mustn't reply to it at all, otherwise I'll be writing for certain foolish things I secretly desire, and which are so worth committing, that I think I'm a cowardly coward for bragging. Some things are terribly difficult for me, just waiting until Easter, and yet I will force myself to do it, thinking that these few weeks will pass. What will happen then, darling, I don't know and I don't think about it. I only know that whenever I think of you, I want you with me to kiss you. And, do you know how often that happens? I'm going to Berlin now and will be there this evening. I'm looking forward to a Friday evening there, but I'm not looking forward to it much; you know how much I love Berlin. Everything is so generous, yet very complicated and interesting. You probably find that in Paris too, and always do, and I envy you for it. In business, I have to work very hard, my love, to achieve anything. If only it could satisfy me and not always leave me with such an empty feeling. Politically, I'm indifferent to everything (at least for the next few weeks, since I honestly don't know what to do or vote for). I'm almost afraid that if things continue like this, we'll have another war in a year. In any case, I'll vote communist, regardless of the economic consequences. Whether it's the right thing to do (I mean tactically) is pure guesswork. But I'm still going to enjoy myself, my love, and I'll definitely write to you more often than before. Just don't scold me if I'm feeling down. Please write to Katz at Berlin Wilsdorf, Mecklenburgische Straße 21/22, on Friday. Lots of love, Hina -23 THE TI RADIO BRINGS ENTERTAINMENT, INCREASES KNOWLEDGE! 1515 25 15 NUREMBERG 15 2.33 22-23 * 21 THE 111 1125 RADIO BRINGS ENTERTAINMENT, INCREASES KNOWLEDGE!
